subject.title: fix (Computer Use) Stabilize Codex Computer Use readiness

question: After the readiness/status bug is fixed, should OpenClaw accept the expanded Codex Computer Use config surface in this PR?
rationale: The code defect is mechanical, but the PR also adds several new operational knobs and defaults in a compatibility-sensitive plugin startup path, which needs maintainer product judgment before merge.

options.title: Accept After Status Fix
options.body: Keep the expanded cache, health, repair, timeout, strict-readiness, and lease settings once failed live probes no longer report ready.

options.title: Narrow The Surface
options.body: Limit this PR to cache reconciliation and truthful readiness/status, then require separate maintainer-sponsored work for health checks, leases, or extra knobs.

recommendation.title: Accept After Status Fix
recommendation.body: Keep the expanded cache, health, repair, timeout, strict-readiness, and lease settings once failed live probes no longer report ready.

likelyOwner.reason: Current main history points to steipete as the strongest routing candidate for Codex app-server and config surface decisions.
